caller: Sir, main Mumbai International Customs Department se Inspector Verma bol raha hoon. Aapka ek parcel pakda gaya hai kya courier office mein?
caller: Wahi toh problem hai sir! Yeh parcel aapke Aadhaar card aur mobile number par Mumbai se Taiwan book hua hai. Isme 5 expired passports, 140 gram MDMA drugs aur laptop mila hai.
caller: Meeting chhoriye sir, aapka arrest warrant issue hone ja raha hai Cyber Crime Bureau se. Aapke naam par Narcotics Act aur Money Laundering ka case darj ho chuka hai.
caller: Local police station jaane ki zaroorat nahi hai. Yeh high-profile international drug syndicate ka case hai. Agar aapne yahan se police station ya kisi ko bataya toh aapko turant ghar se utha liya jayega.
caller: Aapko abhi ke abhi WhatsApp par video call join karni hogi Supreme Court ke verification desk ke saath. Line par hi rahiye, phone cut mat karna bilkul bhi.
